manifest.what: First-hand accounts filed by people who were in the room, with the reporter's name and the date. A report says what one person experienced on one day. It is not a measurement of the venue in general, and it is kept apart from the open map, from what the venue claims about itself, and from anonymous visitor tallies.
manifest.licence: ODbL-1.0 for the catalogue record; the report text and photographs are the reporter's own.

o71358a621d50.reportedKind: Bistro and office space — a café that rents meeting rooms

wifi.detail: Very fast Wi-Fi, measured on the spot twice. The reporter's own Speedtest read 243.78 Mbps down, 218.39 Mbps up, 18 ms ping against the 3BB Nonthaburi server; a second reading from the same visit returned 313.78 Mbps down, 326.51 Mbps up, 9 ms ping. Both are on-site measurements on one day, and they are kept apart rather than averaged.

secondMeasure.method: Speedtest, on site during the visit

seating.detail: Air conditioned and cool inside, clean, good coffee, good vibes — the reporter's words on the day.

power.detail: Many plugs to charge at the seats — the reporter's words on the day.

focus.detail: Quiet — the reporter's word on the day.

value.detail: Cheap for a room like this, and meeting rooms rent from 200 THB an hour.

stay.detail: No long-stay policy was stated to the reporter. Ask the venue.

access.detail: Step-free access was not recorded. Plenty of parking was seen, but parking is not the same as a step-free entrance.

meeting.detail: Meeting rooms to rent, from 200 THB per hour.

speed.detail: Two Speedtest readings taken on site on 12 November 2026: 243.78 Mbps down, 218.39 Mbps up, 18 ms ping, and 313.78 Mbps down, 326.51 Mbps up, 9 ms ping. Both are kept; neither is averaged away.

o71358a621d50.scene: Great decor — the reporter felt it could be England. At the time of the visit it was dressed for Christmas and for Harry Potter, with vintage London in every corner. Dark wood panelling, a chandelier, a long counter, leather armchairs, and bookshelves line the walls. The dressing is seasonal and will change; the report is dated so the reader can weigh it.
